dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the mid-to-upper flank; these feature sharp, high-intensity light-toned perimeters that transition abruptly to dark interiors and a dark surrounding base.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid white, high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated along the dorsal ridge and the posterior section, lacking internal tonal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An elongated triangular geometry is formed by the centroids of the three most prominent 'O' shaped annuli located on the upper-central flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex reticulated pattern of thin, high-contrast lines connects several annular structures in the anterior-dorsal region, creating a distinctive lace-like appearance.
